responsibility: Defines the fundamental x86 target option enums and policy types shared across the backend. This header introduces the stable enumerations for stringop algorithms, calling ABIs, floating-point units, TLS dialects, code models, pointer mode, data alignment policy, assembler dialect, veclib ABI, stack protector guard source, preferred vector width, indirect-branch hardening, return instrumentation, straight-line speculation hardening, and LAM mode, making it the central type-definition companion to the i386 option logic.
